Aasmaan aur raat ko aane waale ki qasam
Aur tum kya jaano ke Taariq kya hai
Yeh ek chamakta hua sitaara hai
Koi nafs aisa nahin hai jis ke oopar nigraan na mu'ayyan kiya gaya ho
Phir insaan dekhe ke use kis cheez se paida kiya gaya hai
Woh ek uchhalte hue paani se paida kiya gaya hai
Jo peeth aur seene ki haddiyon ke darmiyaan se nikalta hai
Yaqeenan woh Khuda insaan ke dobaara paida karne par bhi qaadir hai
Jis din raazon ko aazmaaya jaaega
To phir na kisi ke paas quwwat hogi aur na madadgaar
Qasam hai chakkar khaane waale aasmaan ki
Aur shigaafta hone waali zameen ki
Yeh log apna makr kar rahe hain
Aur hum apni tadbeer kar rahe hain
To kaafiron ko chhod do aur inhein thodi si mohlat de do
